grant.rationale: Narrative says grant. Rules 1.6.2 treat a grant as a contract, so grants stay in scope.

care_or_education_placement.rationale: Placement/care allowances/direct payments by narrative, and contractor payments inside social-care or education services. Appendix C row F excludes some individual care placements from competition, so a flag here may be lawfully outside competition.

agency_staff.rationale: Narrative or supplier text indicating agency or temporary staffing.

premises.rationale: Expenditure category Premises, plus rents, repairs and maintenance, cleaning, grounds maintenance and minor works narratives.

general_procurement.rationale: Default for everything else; ambiguous narratives listed in tagging.unmapped_review.
